mechanism.claim: At a fixed eight-hour boundary in an unusually volatile BTC block, same-direction final-two-hour spot and perpetual returns are more durable when Binance spot aggressive-flow imbalance has the same sign, has absolute magnitude at least 0.10, and is at least 1.5 times the perpetual imbalance magnitude. Follow the cash-led direction for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict nonzero sign of final-two-hour spot return, perpetual return, and spot taker imbalance
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSFLR compares direct spot and perpetual aggressive-flow strength to identify cash leadership. HVAFC used perpetual flow alone; SPVIR used spot volume participation plus BVOL/DVOL ignition; SLVCR used price catch-up rather than taker-flow leadership. No prior event set or control is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed perpetual eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC cross-market flow-leadership clocks are absent from Gross9

features.block_valid: 480 exact aligned distinct minute rows per source in [decision-8h,decision), finite positive coherent OHLC, finite nonnegative quote_asset_volume and taker_buy_quote, taker_buy_quote<=quote_asset_volume, positive final-two-hour quote volume in both sources; no imputation
features.spot_late_return: log(spot close at decision-1m/spot open at decision-2h)
features.perp_late_return: log(perp close at decision-1m/perp open at decision-2h)
features.normalized_taker_imbalance: (2*sum(taker_buy_quote)-sum(quote_asset_volume))/sum(quote_asset_volume) over final two hours, separately by source
features.leadership: abs(spot imbalance)>=0.10 and abs(spot imbalance)>=1.5*abs(perp imbalance)
features.direction_confirmation: spot return, perp return and spot imbalance share one strict nonzero sign
features.realized_variation: sum squared perpetual 1m close-to-close log returns within completed 8h block
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 270 valid fixed eight-hour blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, leadership, or subset repair.
